name: ecommerce-dropshipping-filament
description: The sourcing desk: the suppliers a merchant sources from, what each supplies at what cost and lead time, every purchase transmitted to them replayed from its events, and the purchases nobody can currently account for.
features: No screen anywhere assigns a supplier to an order: routing is a decision over published offers and never an input
No screen anywhere transmits or re-transmits a purchase, because re-sending after a timeout is how the same goods ship twice
A purchase that was sent and not confirmed offers reconcile, which asks the supplier what they have
Reconciling reports four outcomes, and the two that mean nobody was asked and nobody can be asked are told apart
A purchase state is a fold over its append-only events, so no list column is sortable on one and no callback overwrites one
A promise that was never made and a promise that was missed are rendered differently, and neither is rendered as a percentage
A cost variance across two currencies is rendered absent rather than converted, and separately from a supplier who has not stated a cost
Outstanding value is one figure per currency and is never summed across them
A supplier's on-time share is divided here, over measurable despatches only, and a denominator of zero is an em dash rather than nought per cent
No destination, address, name or email is shown on any screen, because the module stores none
Registering a supplier and publishing an offer go through the domain actions, so the natural keys and the currency check apply
No API key is entered, stored or displayed: a supplier names a credential the host's secret store holds
Every screen states its merchant, and a reference belonging to another merchant is not found
Every unpublished Filament ability is forced closed by name, per resource and per relation manager
